mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (current level: 0.1%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between UNRATE and PAYEMS has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, housing starts above 600 thousand units (current level: 604.0) and GDP above 13200 billion dollars (current level: 13260.5) indicate strong economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when the economy is in late-cycle expansion and HOUST exceeds 600.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 5.0% (current level: 9.1%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO above 95) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95 in a post-recession expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A high industrial production index (INDPRO above 90, current level: 94.04) indicates robust manufacturing output and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 90.
